title: Trove social post
description: One line of social/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a single piece of content the vault owner authored (post / comment / reply / repost / quote / edit). Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the item was authored (publish/post/edit time), or a date-only YYYY-MM-DD where the source is day-granular (ratified 2026-07-20 for normalizer imports; a date sorts as a lexical prefix of a timestamp)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (Bluesky record CID/rkey, Mastodon status URI, tweet id, Reddit fullname, HN item id, {domain}:{revid} for a wiki edit, post slug; a hash of (section, ts, text) where an export carries no stable id)

kind.description: "post" (default, a top-level item) | "comment" | "reply" | "repost" | "quote" | "edit" — Reddit submissions + comments, HN stories + comments, microblog replies/boosts/quote-posts, and wiki edits all converge here

text.description: the body, full fidelity (X full_text untruncated, a caption, a Reddit comment, a wiki edit comment) — trimming is a read-time opinion
examples: totally agree — the CAR export is the cleanest part

title.description: the item's title where it has one: HN story, Substack post, Tumblr/Reddit title, the edited page's title for kind:"edit"
examples: Show HN: A local-first personal data vault

url.description: the canonical link: a link-post's target, an HN story URL, or the item's own permalink

lang.description: language tag the source recorded (Mastodon language, Bluesky langs)

reply_to.description: source-native id of the parent this replies/comments on (raw handle, not resolved)

repost_of.description: source-native id of the reposted/boosted/reblogged item (kind:"repost" — carries no text of its own)

quote_of.description: source-native id of the quoted item (kind:"quote" — a repost that does add text)

thread.description: conversation/thread root id, when the source exposes one (Bluesky reply root, Mastodon conversation, Reddit submission of a comment)

context.description: where it was authored: subreddit, Mastodon visibility, Tumblr/Substack blog, wiki domain — a source-native grouping label

tags.description: author-applied tags/hashtags the source records structurally (Tumblr tags)

url.description: URL of the attached media (metadata only, never a copy)

alt.description: the author's alt text / description for the media item
examples: a screenshot of the repo viewer

items.description: one attached-media metadata entry: {type, url, alt}

examples.alt: a screenshot of the repo viewer

media.description: attached media metadata only, never copies: {type, url, alt} per item (image/video/gif; alt = the author's alt text / description)

examples.alt: a screenshot of the repo viewer

extra.description: everything source-specific (engagement counts, post type, revision ids, sizediff, reblog flags, …) — full fidelity
